key_views_to_implement.title: Dashboard KPI & Alert
key_views_to_implement.description: Executive overview showing total active clients, 10-month renewal alerts, pending 6-month store payment resets, energy type split (Luce vs Gas), and quick filter actions.

key_views_to_implement.title: Gestione Clienti (Tabella Avanzata)
key_views_to_implement.description: Searchable, multi-filterable table of clients (Privati & Business P.IVA). Filter by Lavorazione status, Negozio, Fornitore, Contratto Fisso/Variabile, and Pagato/Non Pagato.

key_views_to_implement.title: Inserimento / Modifica Cliente
key_views_to_implement.description: Comprehensive modal/drawer form for registering utility contracts with full field validation (Codice Fiscale, P.IVA, POD 14 chars, PDR 14 digits, IBAN, costs per kW / smc).

key_views_to_implement.title: Scheda Cliente Dettagliata
key_views_to_implement.description: Deep-dive detail sheet showing timeline (Contratto -> Attivazione 2m -> Rinnovo 10m -> Scadenza 12m), tariff comparison, note log, privacy status, payment status, and history.

key_views_to_implement.title: Venditori / Negozi & Commissioni
key_views_to_implement.description: Store performance view (Michael/Tirano, Lorenzo/Sondalo, Kevin/Gravedona). Status Pagato/Non Pagato with automatic 6-month payment reset counter and payment alert notifications.

key_views_to_implement.title: Operatori & Statistiche Lavorazioni
key_views_to_implement.description: Operator workload tracker (Deborah, Enrico...). Monthly processing counts, success rate, status breakdown, and task assignment queue.

key_views_to_implement.title: Centro Alert & Rinnovi 10 Mesi
key_views_to_implement.description: Dedicated alert inbox highlighting contracts reaching the 10-month window, stores pending payment reset at 6 months, and missing documents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Italian Utility CRM app with full compliance with the business logic.

Include a sticky Header with a prominent Role Switcher ('Ruolo Attivo Simulator') allowing instant switching between Admin (Devis), Operatrice (Deborah), Negozio Tirano (Michael), Negozio Sondalo (Lorenzo), and Negozio Gravedona (Kevin) to verify RBAC filtering.
Calculate contract timelines precisely: Activation = Contract Date + 2 months; 10-Month Renewal Alert = Contract Date + 10 months; Contract Expiry = Contract Date + 12 months.
In Negozi section, show 6-month payment reset countdowns with clear alert badges when payment status returns to 'Non Pagato' at 6 months.

Provide rich realistic sample Italian data (e.g. Mario Rossi, Giuseppe Bianchi, Valtellina Eco Srl, etc.) across all 13 tipologie di lavorazione and suppliers (Enel, Eni Plenitude, A2A, Sorgenia, Hera, etc.).

Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, tables, modals, and filters include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='filter-status-select', data-testid='role-selector', data-testid='add-client-button', data-testid='client-row-1').
Use Sonner for toast notifications when updating client statuses, adding new contracts, or marking store payments.
Maintain high visual standard: crisp borders, distinct status badges, responsive mobile drawer navigation, dark/light theme compatibility.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never center align the entire app container.
Do not use dark gradients or muddy full-screen dark gradients; use flat slate backgrounds with crisp 1px borders.
Never use raw AI emojis like 🤖🧠💭; use Lucide-react icons exclusively (Zap, Flame, Building2, User, RefreshCw, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2, Clock, Filter, Search, Plus, FileText).
Ensure input forms have internal padding and clean focus rings.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
